title: Chebyshev quotients, Demazure multiplicities, and Dyck-path models
summary: We study Chebyshev quotients that arise in the representation theory of Lie algebras, specifically within the theory of Demazure flags for fusion products of $\mathfrak{sl}_2[t]$-modules. Using a recent formula that expresses numerical Demazure multiplicities as coefficients of such quotients, we prove a general eventual non-negativity theorem for the same rational functions that compute these multiplicities: each quotient either terminates or has strictly positive coefficients for sufficiently large degrees, which we in turn interpret in terms of matchings and bounded walks.
